more_info.overview: Food Orange 7 is the ethyl ester of beta-apo-8'-carotenic acid. It is an orange-red carotenoid pigment with an ester structure, chemically distinct from the aldehyde beta-apo-8'-carotenal. The general description identifies commercial preparation from apocarotenal. This historical entry concerns the isolated colour preparation, while present food-use conditions must refer to the exact material.
more_info.origin: The general description identifies commercial production from apocarotenal. The reviewed source does not establish one exclusively plant-derived feedstock route for the final isolated colour.
